description: The pie chart represents the distribution of different task types across turns from verified Wildchat journalist-LLM conversations. There are three task types shown: Article generation, Article editing, and Headline generation. Article generation accounts for the largest portion, making up 83.1% of the tasks. Headline generation is the second most common task, comprising 12.8% of the tasks. Article editing is the least common task, making up 4.1% of the tasks. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are labeled inside the corresponding slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
